description: Schema for extracting key information from an invoice document.

issue_date.description: The date when the invoice was issued, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

due_date.description: The date when the invoice payment is due, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

vendor.description: Information about the vendor, supplier, or seller.

name.description: The name of the vendor or supplier.

address.description: The full address of the vendor.

email.description: The email address of the vendor.

customer.description: Information about the customer or recipient of the invoice.

name.description: The name of the customer or bill-to entity.

address.description: The full billing address of the customer.

items.description: A list of line items included in the invoice.

description.description: Description of the item or service.

quantity.description: The quantity of the item or service.

unit_price.description: The price per unit of the item or service.

amount.description: The total amount for this line item (quantity * unit_price).

subtotal.description: The sum of all line item amounts before taxes and discounts.

tax.description: Details about the tax applied to the invoice.

amount.description: The total tax amount applied to the invoice.

rate.description: The tax rate as a decimal (e.g., 0.08875 for 8.875%).

grand_total.description: The final total amount of the invoice, including taxes and other charges.

payment_terms.description: The payment terms specified on the invoice (e.g., 'Net 30').
